# `hearth-hollow-almanac` — Earthy Digital Download (v7.22.2 gold reference — first paste-tested gold sourced from intake-mode flow)

**Source:** Hearth & Hollow Almanac design (Claude Design export from `~/Downloads/Testtt.zip`, generated 2026-05-28 via the v7.22.0 intake-mode flow). First gold where the design itself was generated by the skill's emitted Claude Design prompt — not a pre-existing Claude Design asset.

**Block type:** `surecart/product-page`
**Pattern name:** `hearth-hollow-almanac`
**Output file:** [`hearth-hollow-almanac.example.html`](./hearth-hollow-almanac.example.html) (~38 KB, 7 sections)
**Paste-test status:** **CLEAN after 2 fix iterations** — `invalid_count: 0` post-paste at v7.22.2. Iterations surfaced 4 new HCs (#50/#51/#52/#53) and produced this as the canonical artifact.

> **First gold to close the full intake-mode loop** — merchant intake questionnaire → emitted Claude Design prompt → design.claude.com export → conversion → clean WP editor paste. Validates the v7.22.x intake architecture end-to-end.

## Why this exemplar exists

Earlier R-series golds (atlas-greens R2 / lumen-saas R3 / halcyon-field-jacket R4) were derived from pre-existing Claude Design exports. **R5 is the first gold sourced from the skill's own intake-mode flow** — the merchant ran `/surecart-design-to-blocks` empty, answered 7 questions (digital download + warm orange accent + 1-axis variants + multi-tier pricing + earthy & organic mood + serif display + sans body), pasted the emitted prompt into design.claude.com, and brought the resulting 4-file zip back here for conversion.

Also covers untested dimensions:

1. **Digital download archetype with multi-tier pricing** — `surecart/product-price-chooser` paired with a single template child (server expands per merchant tier config). First gold without inline `<ProductPrice/>` + `<PriceScratch/>` + `<PriceInterval/>` family — the chooser block alone handles the pricing UI.
2. **Earthy & organic mood with literal-hex palette** — Claude Design extrapolated 14 invented `surecart-*` slugs (`-orange-100/500/700`, `-oak-900`, `-olive-700/200`, `-ochre-500`, `-cream-50`, etc.) that don't exist in `theme-partial.json`. Per HC#13 the converter never invents slugs; falls back to literal-hex with D7 dual-emit on every leaf. Page renders correctly on any theme without preset registration.
3. **L/R reviews layout** — summary LEFT + per-review template RIGHT, both inside `surecart/product-reviews` wrapper inside `surecart/product-review-list`. Validates HC#53's canonical structure (the wrap-with-product-reviews-then-2-col pattern).
4. **HC#50 review-template inner-block correctness** — `reviewer-name` + `verified-badge` + `date` + `rating-stars` + `title` + `content` (NOT `-author-info` / `-rating` hallucinations).
5. **HC#52 separator alpha-channel-opacity** — divider in hero buy column with `opacity:"alpha-channel"` + `has-alpha-channel-opacity` class.

## Selection guidance

Use this exemplar as the gold reference for:

- **Digital download archetype** — pay-once-own-forever language, no shipping chrome, instant-download pill, format variants (PDF/ePub size axis)
- **Multi-tier price-chooser** — `surecart/product-price-chooser` with single `product-price-choice-template` child, server expansion per merchant tier config
- **Earthy & organic mood with custom palette** — when the design's color tokens don't snap to `theme-partial.json` slugs, literal-hex with D7 dual-emit is the right path (this exemplar emits 14 literal hexes cleanly)
- **L/R reviews layout via HC#53** — when the design shows summary alongside review cards rather than stacked above them
- **First-loop intake-mode reference** — when running intake mode against an earthy / editorial / digital brand voice, this is the canonical paste-tested target shape

## Companion exemplar for Q5 = Earthy & organic

Alongside `halcyon-field-jacket (R4)` for physical earthy products, this exemplar covers the digital-download earthy variant. `intake/shared/typography-presets.md` Q5=Earthy mapping lists both:

- **`halcyon-field-jacket (R4)`** — Physical apparel; size + color variants; lookbook gallery; size guide; brand story
- **`hearth-hollow-almanac (R5)`** — Digital download; format variant; multi-tier pricing; 3-step explainer; 5-item FAQ

The intake-mode resolver should pick R5 over R4 when `Q1 = Digital download / Online course / SaaS` AND `Q5 = Earthy & organic`. Otherwise R4 remains the default earthy reference.
